# `fnox mcp`

- **Usage:** `fnox mcp`

Start an MCP server that brokers secrets to AI agents

## Flags

- **`-h --help`** — Print help

<!-- fnox examples:start -->

## Examples

Run a stdio MCP server from the project directory. Configure its secret allowlist and authenticate to providers before starting the client.

```sh
fnox mcp
fnox --profile staging mcp
```
